raw_text: Indian Navy ASW ops in Bay of Bengal. Sources confirm sustained tracking of subsurface contact east of Andaman Islands. Multiple P-8I sorties and surface combatant involvement. Contact classified as nuclear-powered. Duration: 72+ hours. This is one of the longest publicly known ASW tracking operations by the Indian Navy.
